about: GLM-5.3-Flash EXL3 3.05bpw on one RTX 3090 inside 55 GiB of host RAM plus one Intel Arc Pro B70 as a second GPU expert tier: the 55 GiB NVMe mode (glm53-flash-offload afdf390 = v4.5-b70, GLM53_MODE=nvme) with GLM53_B70=1; a companion container on the B70 (glm53-b70-expert-server) holds 3,000 routed experts and computes their decode picks (campaign N137). CANDIDATE: no plugin runs a companion yet
setup: CANDIDATE (not in the plugin catalog: the plugin runs one container per recipe today). NEEDS: one RTX 3090 24 GB and one Intel Arc Pro B70 32 GB in the same machine, plus everything the 55 GiB NVMe launch needs (exllamav3-glm-5.3-flash-exl3-3.05bpw-nvme-55g-128k-rtx-3090-24gb: 55 GiB cap, memlock unlimited, AVX2+FMA+F16C, >= 40 CPUs, the 117.3 GB packed store from `pack-store` on local NVMe). COMPANION: glm53-b70-expert-server on the B70 (one render node, ZE_AFFINITY_MASK=0, 16 GiB cap = memoryBytes = memorySwapBytes, memlock unlimited, no network) starts FIRST; it uses prepare.at (the same prepared /nvx pack, read-only; it does not read the model weights) and creates the ring /run/local-ai/shared/b70.ring in the tmpfs dir shared with the engine. The engine (GLM53_B70=1) waits for the ring inside its own start (up to GLM53_B70_WAIT_S = 180 s, then refuses), sends the server the 3,000 experts that follow its VRAM set by routing score at warm-up (28.4 GB loaded from /nvx in ~5 s), drops them from the RAM tier, and masks their decode picks on the 3090; the CPU worker posts them to the B70 and adds the B70's rows to its partial. Prefill keeps the staged path (exact). MEASURED (omarchy, 2026-10-09, campaign N137, same session, image v4.2-nvme + this serving code mounted, sweep --template glm, natural completions; EPYC 7443P, 503 GiB DDR4, PCIe 4.0, 4x Samsung 9100 PRO RAID0, B70 at 0000:48:00.0): tier off / on: prefill 8k 657 / 648-658, 32k 966 / 968-974 tok/s; decode C1 17.48 / 26.40-26.61, C2 17.84 / 30.34-30.63 agg, C4 19.11 / 33.00-33.54 agg, 32k C1 16.28 / 24.60-24.92, 32k C2 17.35 / 29.09 tok/s; 120 GiB cap (all experts in RAM) 8k C1/C2/C4 22.09/23.32/24.64 -> 28.51/34.55/39.99. QUALITY: teacher-forced panel top-1 1.0000, KL 0 (2,154 positions); paired decode-KL vs the exact GPU path 0.0034 (p99 0.064), top-1 0.988 (the shipped nvme mode: 0.0070 / 0.980); B70 expert outputs vs fp64 rel L2 0.0013-0.0015 on 48 real experts. Images: engine v4.5-b70 (local-ai-images run 37883462672), companion glm53-b70-expert-server:v1 (run 37883460041, built from the same commit). Not yet lab-run (six gates) on these digests; the numbers are the owner's campaign runs (reported).
